summary: Character/line conversions unconditionally recognized all Unicode line breaks, ignoring the configured line-break features. The fix uses the feature-selected lines module. This reversal isolates char_to_line_idx. The test added by the fix should detect it with `cargo test --no-default-features --lib str_utils::tests::char_to_line_idx_01 -- --exact`: at character index 38, LF-only mode expects line 2, while the buggy implementation returns 8. Default features enable unicode_lines and would mask the bug. No tests were executed.
